stops.title: Yu Sɛtin dɛn
stops.caption: Akawnt, sikyuriti, aw i luk.
stops.speech: Sɛtin kɔva yu akawnt, aw yu de sayn in, aw Kairos de luk, ɛn wetin langwej i de tɔk to yu.

stops.title: Notifikeshɔn
stops.caption: Wetin de rich yu, ɛn omɔch tɛm.
stops.speech: Notifikeshɔn na pɛ katigɔri. Pik naw naw ɔ wan de sɔmari fɔ ɛvri wan, ɔ tɔn am ɔf. Sikyuriti alat de kam ɔltɛm.
